exposure: labor status at admission (preactive or active)
cohort: This study included 27,077 low-risk, nulliparous women admitted to hospitals for spontaneous labor onset, from the Consortium on Safe Labor.
finding: Adoption of evidence-based, standardized approaches for diagnosing active labor onset, assessing labor progress, and diagnosing dystocia may safely decrease oxytocin augmentation and cesarean birth rates.
